Kuvitus: pimeä huone illalla. Pöydällä o: Illustration: a dark room in the evening. On a table there is a torch whose side has been drawn open: inside are two batteries in a row, a spring and a switch. The beam of the lamp lights the table and the wall on the right.
Suljettu virtapiiri pöydällä. Alhaalla v: A closed circuit on a table. At the bottom left two AA batteries in a row in a holder, the positive terminal on the right. From the positive terminal of the battery a wire goes to the right through a closed switch, rises to the upper right corner and goes left along the top through a lamp. The lamp is lit. The wire returns down the left edge to the negative terminal of the battery. Violet arrows show the conventional direction of current: from the positive terminal through the external circuit to the negative terminal. Schematic figure, not to scale.
Johdon pala suurennettuna. Uloinna on mu: A piece of wire magnified. On the outside is a plastic insulating sheath, and inside it a copper conductor. In the copper there are positive metal ions in a regular lattice and free electrons between them. A blue arrow points to the left: the free electrons move to the left. A violet arrow points to the right: the conventional direction of current is opposite to the motion of the electrons. Schematic figure, not to scale.
Kytkentäkaavion piirrosmerkit kahdessa s: The symbols of a circuit diagram in two columns. On the left from top to bottom: a battery, where the long thin line is the positive terminal and the short thick line the negative terminal; a lamp, a circle with a cross inside; a resistor, a rectangle; an ammeter, a circle with an A inside. On the right: an open switch with its lever lifted away, a closed switch with its lever in contact, a wire, a junction as a dot, and a voltmeter, a circle with a V inside.
Kuvan 2 virtapiiri kytkentäkaaviona. Suo: The circuit of Figure 2 as a circuit diagram. A rectangular loop. At the bottom left two battery cells in a row, the long line, that is the positive terminal, on the right. At the bottom right a closed switch, in the middle of the top edge a lamp, a circle with a cross. A violet arrow next to the right edge points upwards and is labelled I: the current flows from the positive terminal through the switch and the lamp to the negative terminal.
Kuparijohdin suurennettuna. Johdon keske: A copper wire magnified. In the middle of the wire a cross-section is drawn with a dashed line. Blue electrons fill the whole wire, and they move to the left through the cross-section. At the top right a stopwatch. A violet arrow above the wire points to the right and is labelled I. Labels: in the time t a charge Q passes through the cross-section. Schematic figure, not to scale.
Paristo vasemmalla ja lamppu oikealla, v: A battery on the left and a lamp on the right, between them an orange arrow of energy flow from the battery to the lamp. The battery is labelled with the voltage U equal to 1.5 volts, the arrow with the energy 1.5 joules for every coulomb. The lamp radiates light and heat. At the top a wire goes from the positive terminal of the battery to the side of the lamp, at the bottom a wire returns from the base of the lamp to the bottom of the battery, and a violet arrow shows that the same charge circulates back to the battery. Schematic figure.
sama varaus palaa paristolle: the same charge returns to the battery
Kuvaaja virrasta ajan funktiona. Vaaka-a: A graph of current as a function of time. On the horizontal axis the time t in seconds 0–60, on the vertical axis the current I in amperes 0–0.5. The current is 0.40 amperes for the time 0–20 seconds, then 0.10 amperes for the time 20–50 seconds and after that zero.
Mallikaavio. Suorakulmion muotoinen silm: A model diagram. A rectangular loop. On the left edge two battery cells in a row standing upright, the positive terminals up. On the top edge a switch and a lamp, on the right edge an ammeter, a circle with an A. A violet arrow above the top edge points to the right and is labelled I.
Opiskelijan piirtämä kytkentäkaavio. Vas: A circuit diagram drawn by a student. On the left an upright battery, the positive terminal at the top. From the positive terminal a wire rises and runs to the right along the top edge through a closed switch and a lamp, goes down the right edge and returns to the left along the bottom edge. The wire at the bottom turns up and joins the wire of the top edge at a dot above the positive terminal of the battery. From the negative terminal of the battery a short wire goes down and ends in nothing.
Kytkentäkaavio. Vasemmassa reunassa pari: A circuit diagram. On the left edge a battery. On the top edge two lamp symbols, circles with a cross, in a row. On the bottom edge an open switch. All are in the same closed loop.
A circuit diagram. On the left edge a battery. On the top edge two rectangles in a row. On the bottom edge an open switch. All are in the same closed loop.

A circuit diagram. On the left edge a battery. On the top edge two lamp symbols, circles with a cross, in a row. The wire on the bottom edge is continuous. From its middle a short wire goes downwards, with an open switch at its end, leading nowhere.
